#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 1000000007;
const long long INF = (long long)1e18 + 1;

long long nCr[100][100];

long long f(long long p, int a, int b, int c, int d) {
    p = (p * nCr[a][b]) % MOD;
    p = (p * nCr[c][d]) % MOD;
    return p;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    int n, K;
    cin >> n >> K;

    // Precompute nCr
    for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
            if (j == 0 || j == i) nCr[i][j] = 1;
            else nCr[i][j] = (nCr[i-1][j] + nCr[i-1][j-1]) % MOD;
        }
    }

    int cnt1 = 0, cnt2 = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        if (x == 50) cnt1++;
        else cnt2++;
    }

    // dist[x][y][z]: minimum number of trips to reach state (x,y,z)
    vector<vector<vector<long long>>> dist(200, vector<vector<long long>>(200, vector<long long>(2, INF)));
    vector<vector<vector<long long>>> dp(200, vector<vector<long long>>(200, vector<long long>(2, 0)));

    dist[0][0][0] = 0;
    dp[0][0][0] = 1;

    queue<tuple<int,int,int>> q;
    q.push({0, 0, 0});

    while (!q.empty()) {
        auto [x, y, z] = q.front();
        q.pop();
        long long d = dist[x][y][z];

        if (z == 0) {
            int rx = cnt1 - x;
            int ry = cnt2 - y;
            for (int i = 0; i <= rx; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= ry; j++) {
                    if (i + j == 0) continue;
                    if (i * 50 + j * 100 > K) break;
                    int nx = x + i;
                    int ny = y + j;
                    int nz = 1;
                    if (dist[nx][ny][nz] >= d + 1) {
                        long long add = f(dp[x][y][z], rx, i, ry, j);
                        if (dist[nx][ny][nz] > d + 1) {
                            dist[nx][ny][nz] = d + 1;
                            q.push({nx, ny, nz});
                        }
                        dp[nx][ny][nz] = (dp[nx][ny][nz] + add) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            int rx = x;
            int ry = y;
            for (int i = 0; i <= rx; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= ry; j++) {
                    if (i + j == 0) continue;
                    if (i * 50 + j * 100 > K) break;
                    int nx = x - i;
                    int ny = y - j;
                    int nz = 0;
                    if (dist[nx][ny][nz] >= d + 1) {
                        long long add = f(dp[x][y][z], rx, i, ry, j);
                        if (dist[nx][ny][nz] > d + 1) {
                            dist[nx][ny][nz] = d + 1;
                            q.push({nx, ny, nz});
                        }
                        dp[nx][ny][nz] = (dp[nx][ny][nz] + add) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (dist[cnt1][cnt2][1] == INF) cout << -1 << '\n';
    else cout << dist[cnt1][cnt2][1] << '\n';
    cout << dp[cnt1][cnt2][1] << '\n';

    return 0;
}
</translated_code>
